seo.title: Rent Ready | Property services for owners and landlords
seo.description: Rent Ready helps with small repairs, preparing homes for rent or sale, inspections, condition reports and key services.
seo.openGraphTitle: Rent Ready | Your property, ready for the next step
seo.openGraphDescription: Practical property services for owners, landlords and real estate professionals.
seo.schemaDescription: Professional property service for small repairs, rent or sale preparation, inspections, condition reports and key services.

hero.text: Rent Ready helps private individuals, owners and landlords with practical work in and around the home, from small repairs to fully preparing a property for rent or sale.

servicesSection.title: Practical help for your home or property
servicesSection.intro: From a small repair to getting an entire home ready again. Rent Ready focuses on concrete solutions and a tidy result.
servicesSection.scopeNote: Rent Ready focuses on small repairs and property services. For larger or specialist work, we look at the best solution together.

repairs.title: Small repairs & property service
repairs.text: Practical repairs, assembly, small adjustments and other jobs that have been left undone or need to be solved quickly.

rentReady.title: Preparing for rent or sale
rentReady.text: We help make a home clean, functional and presentable again for a new tenant, buyer or viewing.

inspection.title: Inspection, condition report & key service
inspection.text: Practical support with checks, condition reports, key handovers and access to the property.

whySection.title: Not just odd jobs. A reliable property partner.
whySection.intro: You do not need to find a different solution for every small problem. Rent Ready looks at what is needed, makes clear agreements and gets it done.

singleContact.title: One point of contact
singleContact.text: Simple communication and one contact person for practical follow-up.

clearAgreements.title: Clear agreements
clearAgreements.text: Clear in advance about what we do, when and under which conditions.

fastPractical.title: Fast and practical
fastPractical.text: No unnecessary complexity. We look for a workable solution and get started.

jobToHandover.title: From job to handover
jobToHandover.text: We look beyond one isolated task and keep the end result in mind.

audienceSection.title: For anyone who wants to get a property practically in order
audienceSection.intro: Rent Ready works for private owners, landlords and real estate professionals who want to move forward quickly and reliably.

owners.title: Private owners
owners.text: For practical work, small repairs and help in or around your own home.

landlords.title: Landlords
landlords.text: For transitions between tenants, checks, repairs and getting a property ready to rent again.

propertyOwners.title: Property owners & investors
propertyOwners.text: For practical follow-up of one or more properties without having to be on site for every task.

agents.title: Real estate professionals
agents.text: As a practical partner when a property still needs to be put in order before rent, sale or handover.

processSection.title: Simple, from request to result
processSection.intro: No complicated process. We review the job, make clear agreements and make sure the work moves forward.

request.title: Get in touch
request.text: Briefly send us what needs to be done, preferably with a few photos.

align.title: We align
align.text: We review the job, timing and practical arrangements.

execution.title: We carry it out
execution.text: The agreed work is handled practically and carefully.

done.title: Done
done.text: You receive clear feedback and the property is ready for the next step.

areaSection.title: Based in Landen, active across a broad region
areaSection.intro: Rent Ready works from Landen and helps clients in areas including Tienen, Sint-Truiden, Leuven, Hasselt, Hannut and Brussels.
areaSection.extended: Depending on the job, travel outside this core area is also possible.
areaSection.question: Not sure whether your property is within our service area?

contactSection.title: What needs to be done?
contactSection.intro: Send us a brief description of what you need. With a few photos, we can often quickly assess how we can best help.
